g.text: Implemented optional topology • recreate / reseed when moving hosts • configured capacities are not measured peaks
Runs fulfillment and the shared infrastructure containers.
Lima / VZ · Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 · Docker + Compose
Configured: 4 vCPU · 4 GiB RAM · 40 GiB sparse disk limit
Stores the two private owner databases.
Host btop and guest btop describe different resources.
Lima forwards only the configured lab ports onto the selected private host address.
Cross-host observations: operator reads fulfillment HTTP :4312, RabbitMQ management :15629 and proxy administration :8474.
Return data: readiness, settings, jobs/attempts, outbox counts, queue measurements and activity. No cross-owner table reads.
Compose caps: PostgreSQL 1 GiB / 1 CPU; RabbitMQ 768 MiB / 1 CPU; Redis 128 MiB / 0.5 CPU;
Toxiproxy 64 MiB / 0.5 CPU; fulfillment 512 MiB / 1 CPU. Native apps and guest overhead add resource use.
